name: publish_lesson
description:
Publish and synchronize a new fleet rule or skill across all agent entry points.

    Args:
        lesson_type: "rule" or "skill"
        name: Name or heading of the rule (min 2 chars), or kebab-case name of the skill.
        description: Description of the skill (required for skills, optional for rules).
        content: Markdown instructions body or rule directive content.
        category: Optional category classification (default: "directive").
        triggers: Optional trigger phrases for skill discovery.
        dry_run: If True, validate without altering filesystem.
        overwrite: If True, allow overwriting existing skill directory.

    Returns:
        Structured JSON dictionary containing success flag, error_code, message, and files_modified.
